questions.question: Which of the numbers given below is divisible by 11?
questions.solution:
Concept used:

The divisibility by 11 rule states that if the difference of the sum of the digits at odd places and even places of the number is 0 or divisible by 11, then the given number is also divisible by 11.

Calculation:

Considering the options one by one,

Option 1, 359247615447536920 ⇒ (3 + 9 + 4 + 6 + 5 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 2) - (5 + 2 + 7 + 1 + 4 + 7 + 3 + 9 + 0) = 1, not divisible by 11.

Option 2, 359247615447536923 ⇒ (3 + 9 + 4 + 6 + 5 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 2) - (5 + 2 + 4 + 6 + 5 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 2) = 5, not divisible by 11.

Option 3, 35924761544753698 ⇒ (3 + 9 + 4 + 6 + 5 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 8) - (5 + 2 + 7 + 1 + 4 + 7 + 3 + 9) = 12, not divisible by 11.

Option 4, 359247615447536915 ⇒ (3 + 9 + 4 + 6 + 5 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 1) - (5 + 2 + 7 + 1 + 4 + 7 + 3 + 9 + 5) = 0, divisible by 11.

∴ Option 4 is divisible by 11.

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

options.text: Sperms containing X chromosome have 22 chromosomes but sperms containing Y chromosome have 23 chromosomes.
Sperms containing X chromosome have 23 chromosomes but sperms containing Y chromosome have 22 chromosomes.
Sperms containing X chromosome have 23 chromosomes and sperms containing Y chromosome also have 23 chromosomes.
Sperms containing X chromosome have 22 chromosomes and sperms containing Y chromosome also have 22 chromosomes.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sperms containing X chromosome have 23 chromosomes and sperms containing Y chromosome also have 23 chromosomes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Human cells, including sperm cells, typically contain 23 pairs of chromosomes (for a total of 46 chromosomes).
 
• These chromosomes carry the genetic information that determines an individual's traits.
 
• Of these 23 pairs, 22 pairs are called autosomes, which are identical in males and females.
 
• The 23rd pair consists of the sex chromosomes, which determine an individual's sex.
 
• Females have two X chromosomes (XX), while males have one X chromosome and one Y chromosome (XY).
 
• During sperm formation in males, the sex chromosomes separate. This means that each sperm cell will receive either an X chromosome or a Y chromosome.
 
• Therefore, sperm cells containing an X chromosome will have 23 chromosomes in total.
 
• Similarly, sperm cells containing a Y chromosome will also have 23 chromosomes in total.
 
• The sex of the offspring is determined by which sperm cell fertilizes the egg. If a sperm cell carrying an X chromosome fertilizes the egg (which always carries an X chromosome), the resulting offspring will be female (XX).
 
• If a sperm cell carrying a Y chromosome fertilizes the egg, the resulting offspring will be male (XY).

questions.question: The cost that a firm incurs to employ fixed inputs is called:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**total fixed cost**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fixed Costs: **These are expenses that a business must pay regardless of the level of production or sales. They remain constant within a specific production period.
 
• **Fixed Inputs:** These are resources that a firm cannot easily change in the short run. Examples include:
 
• Rent or lease payments for buildings and equipment: These costs remain the same regardless of how much output is produced.
 
• Salaries of permanent employees: Even if production decreases, the company still needs to pay salaries to its core workforce.
 
• Insurance premiums: These costs are typically fixed for a certain period.
 
• Property taxes: These taxes are assessed on the property owned by the business and remain relatively stable.
 
• **Key Characteristics:**
 
 
• Independent of output: Fixed costs do not change with the level of production.
 
• Incurred even at zero output: A firm still incurs fixed costs even if it produces nothing.
 
• Relevant in the short run: In the short run, some inputs are fixed, leading to fixed costs. In the long run, all inputs can be adjusted, and thus, all costs become variable.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Understanding Fixed Costs:**

 
 
• Importance in Decision-Making: Fixed costs are crucial for businesses to understand. They significantly impact profitability and pricing decisions.
 
• Contribution Margin: The contribution margin, which is the difference between sales revenue and variable costs, helps determine how much revenue contributes towards covering fixed costs and generating profit.
 
• Break-Even Analysis: Break-even analysis helps determine the level of sales needed to cover both fixed and variable costs and achieve profitability.

questions.question: The resistance of a conductor is directly proportional to its __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Length**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **resistance of a conductor is directly proportional to length.**
 
• The resistance of a **wire is directly proportional to its length and inversely proportional** to its** cross-sectional area**.
 
• As the length of the conductor increases, the resistance increases proportionally.
 
• This is because electrons have to travel a longer distance through the material, encountering more collisions and thus more resistance.
 
• Resistance **also depends on the material of the conductor.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The dissipation of electric energy in the form of heat, even though small, affects the amount of electromotive force, or electromotive force,e, required to produce a given current through the circuit.
 
• In fact, the **electromotive force V **(measured in volts) across a circuit divided by the current I (amperes) through that circuit defines quantitatively the amount of electricity.
 
• resistance R. 
 
 
• **Precisely, R = V/I. **
 
 
 
• Thus, if a 12-volt battery steadily drives a two-ampere current through a length of wire, the wire has a resistance of six volts per ampere or six ohms.
 
• The ohm is the common unit of electrical resistance, equivalent to one volt per ampere and represented by the capital Greek **letter omega, Ω.**

questions.question: A and B are emptying pipes and C is a filling pipe. Pipes A and B can empty a full tank in 15 hours and 18 hours, respectively. When all three pipes are opened together, it takes 1(1)/(4) hours to empty (1)/(9) part of the tank. In how many hours can pipe C alone fill (2)/(3) part of the tank?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net emptying part in 1 hour by (A + B + C) = (1/9) ÷ (5/4) = 4/45 part/hour.

Part emptied by A and B in 1 hour = 1/15 + 1/18 = 11/90 part/hour.

Filling part by C in 1 hour = (Part emptied by A + B) − Net emptying part.

Efficiency of C = 11/90 − 4/45 = 11/90 − 8/90 = 3/90 = 1/30 part/hour.

Time required for C to fill 2/3 part = (2/3) ÷ (1/30) = 20 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Time taken by A to empty the tank = 15 hours

Time taken by B to empty the tank = 18 hours

Time taken by A, B, and C to empty 1/9 part of the tank = 5/4 hours

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time taken by A, B, and C together to empty the full tank = (5/4) × 9 = 45/4 hours

⇒ Let the total capacity of the tank be the LCM of (15, 18, and 45) = 90 units.

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 8 hours. Pipes B and C can empty the full tank in 20 hours and 15 hours, respectively. Pipes A and B are opened together for 5 hours, and then B is closed, and C is opened instantly. The tank will be full in a total time of:

Pipe A alone can fill the tank in 8 hours

Concept used:

In this type of (pipe and cistern) question, we assume the capacity of the tank as the LCM of number of hours taken to fill the tank.

Total Capacity of tank = Efficiency of pipe × Number of hours

Calculation:

Suppose the capacity of the tank is (LCM of 8, 20 and 15) i.e. 120 litres

⇒ Part of tank filled by pipe A in 1 hour = 120/8 = 15 litres

⇒ Part of tank emptied by pipe B in 1 hour = 120/20 = 6 litres

⇒ Part of tank emptied by pipe C in 1 hour = 120/15 = 8 litres

According to question

Volume of tank is filled when Pipe A and B opened together for 5 hours= (15 - 6) × 5 = 45 litres

Remaining capacity of tank = 120 - 25 = 75 litres

Time taken by Pipe A and Pipe C when opened together = 75/(15 - 8)

⇒ 95/7 hours

Total time taken to filled an empty tank = 5 + 75/7

⇒ 110/7

⇒ 15(5)/(7) hours

Tank will be full in a total time of 15(5)/(7) hours.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**

__
 
• **Article 44 of the Directive Principles** in the Constitution says:

 
 
• "State shall endeavor to provide for its citizens a** uniform civil code (UCC)__ **throughout the territory of India".
 
 
 
• The **objective of Article 44** of the Directive Principles in the Indian Constitution was to address the discrimination against vulnerable groups and harmonize diverse cultural groups across the country.
 
• The Uniform Civil Code (UCC) calls for the formulation of one law for India, which would be applicable to all religious communities in matters such as marriage, divorce, inheritance, adoption.
 
• The origin of the UCC dates back to colonial India when the British government submitted its report in 1835 stressing the need for uniformity in the codification of Indian law relating to crimes, evidence, and contracts, specifically recommending that personal laws of Hindus and Muslims be kept outside such codification.

• **Calculate Focal Length (f):**
 
 
• f = R / 2 = -20.0 cm / 2 = -10.0 cm
 
 
 
• **Use the Mirror Equation to find Image Distance (v):**
 
 
• 1/f = 1/v + 1/u
 
• 1/v = 1/f - 1/u
 
• 1/v = 1/(-10.0 cm) - 1/(-40.0 cm)
 
• 1/v = -1/10 + 1/40
